templates.name: Bid clarification
templates.use: Use only for an actionable bid clarification. C1A bid discovery results belong in K0; discovery does not authorize an email.
templates.subject: Clarification on {{bid_title}} | {{bid_reference}}

blocks.text: We’re putting our ideas together for {{bid_title}} and have a couple of questions before we get started:
Could you help us with these by {{reply_by}}? We’d like to make sure the proposal fits what you have in mind.

templates.key: C1B Reconnect after a past RFP
templates.name: Reconnect after a past RFP
templates.use: Do not imply BSE delivered an event when the evidence only shows an RFP. The source template’s optional 5-business-day follow-up is retained below; it is not scheduled in the map.
templates.subject: Upcoming events at {{company}}

blocks.text: What’s taking shape at {{company}}? We last connected through your RFP for {{past_event}} in {{month_year}}, and we’d love to hear what’s next.
A town hall, a team celebration, something a little unexpected? Send us the brief, event date and target budget—even if the idea is still on the drawing board. We’d be happy to explore it with you.

templates.name: Optional reconnection follow-up
templates.use: Draft only. Source suggests 5 business days; activate only after Kiko resolves the map/template mismatch.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: Popping back in about {{company}}’s upcoming events. If you have an idea or a brief taking shape, we’d love to hear about it.
If someone else on your team handles events, could you point us their way?

templates.name: Introduction
templates.subject: What’s next for {{company}}? | Blank Space Events

blocks.text: I’m Kiko from Blank Space Events. We turn event ideas into experiences people can enjoy together—from town halls and sports fests to year-end celebrations.
I’ve attached our portfolio so you can get a feel for what we bring to life. What’s on {{company}}’s event calendar? We’d love to hear what you have in mind and explore it with you.

templates.name: First follow-up
templates.use: Every 3 business days; maximum 2 follow-ups, then park. Keep the existing thread.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: Picking up my note from {{date_sent}}—have you had a chance to browse the portfolio I attached? If an event is taking shape at {{company}}, I’d love to hear about it and swap a few ideas.
I’ll leave the door open for now. When the next event idea comes along at {{company}}, we’d love to help bring it to life.

templates.name: Reply follow-through
templates.use: Suggested reply for Kiko’s review after 2 business days without action. Do not invent a delivery commitment.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: Anything else you’d like us to work into the plan? Just reply here.

templates.name: Accreditation submission
templates.use: First message remains manual. Confirm every listed attachment is present before sending.
templates.subject: Vendor accreditation documents | Blank Space Events

blocks.text: Here are our vendor accreditation documents for {{company}}:
Could you let us know they’ve arrived? If there’s anything else you need from us, we’re happy to help.

templates.name: Accreditation status follow-up
templates.use: After more than 5 business days of silence; at most once a week per company.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: Checking in on the accreditation documents we sent on {{submission_date}}. How are things looking? If there’s anything left for us to complete, just let us know.

templates.key: C5 Introduction within an accredited company
templates.name: Introduction within an accredited company
templates.use: Only state accreditation after verification. Add a past-event sentence only when BSE’s delivery is documented.
templates.subject: Event support for your team at {{company}}

blocks.text: I’m Kiko from Blank Space Events. We’re an accredited vendor at {{company}}, and we’d love to get to know your team and the events you’re imagining.
May I send over our portfolio? Or, if there’s already an idea brewing, we can start with a quick chat.

templates.name: Cost estimate ready
templates.use: Canvas CTA required. Use the current client-accessible CE signing link; show signing language only when signing is enabled.
templates.subject: Your event starts taking shape | {{event}}

blocks.text: Let’s bring this event to life. Your cost estimate for {{event}} on {{event_date}} is ready in Canvas.
Take a look at the scope, inclusions and payment terms, then sign when you’re ready to move ahead. Have a question or an idea to work in? Reply here and let’s talk it through.
Take a look at your estimate

templates.name: Cost estimate follow-up
templates.use: First after 3 days, then every 5 days; maximum 3 chasers.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: Checking in on the cost estimate for {{event}} we sent on {{date_sent}}. Your next step is waiting in Canvas—take a look and sign when you’re ready.
Need a change, a clarification or a little more time? Just let us know.

templates.name: Urgent cost estimate follow-up
templates.use: For events within 7 days. Deadline must come from the project; do not imply supplier availability is guaranteed.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: {{event}} is coming up on {{event_date}}. Could you review the cost estimate and let us know your decision by {{confirmation_deadline}}? That will help us line up the next production steps.
If there’s something you’d like to talk through first, reply here—we’re ready to help.

templates.name: Client payment follow-up
templates.use: From info@ with Kiko in CC. Overdue invoices only; first after 7 days, then every 7 days; maximum 3. Reply is the primary CTA unless a verified client billing portal exists.
templates.subject: Payment follow-up | BI {{invoice_number}} | {{event}}

blocks.text: A quick check-in on billing invoice {{invoice_number}} for {{event}}.
Could you share the expected payment date? If you’ve already paid, thank you—please reply with the proof so we can match it to the invoice.

templates.name: Friday event update
templates.use: Friday draft appears in K0. Use a client-authorized view; never send an internal project URL to a client.
templates.subject: {{event}} | Weekly update | {{update_date}}

blocks.text: Here’s what’s taking shape for {{event}} this week.
The full picture is in Canvas. Take a look, and reply here if there’s anything you’d like to talk through.

templates.name: Supplier accreditation request
templates.use: Use the actual form URL. It may be an external form; classify it as Canvas only after its destination is verified.
templates.subject: Complete your supplier accreditation | Blank Space Events

blocks.text: Let’s get {{supplier}} set up for {{event}}. Please complete our Vendor Accreditation Form so we have the right details for your payments.
Keep your TIN, bank name, account name and account number handy, along with {{required_documents}}.
Need a hand with the form? Just reply here.

templates.name: Accreditation follow-up
templates.use: First after 3 days, then every 3 days; maximum 3.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: A quick nudge to complete your supplier accreditation for {{event}}. We’ll need those details before we can process your payment.
Already sent it? Thanks! Let us know and we’ll check it on our side.

templates.name: Request for proposal
templates.use: Sent through Canvas Send RFP from Kiko’s Gmail. Sending through Canvas does not establish that a supplier quotation portal exists; reply remains the default CTA.
templates.subject: Quotation request | {{scope}} | {{event}}

blocks.text: We’re putting {{event}} together and would love a quotation from you for {{scope}}.
Please send an itemized quote with inclusions, exclusions, lead time, availability and payment terms. You can reply with it right here.
Have a question about the brief? Let’s clear it up before you quote.

templates.name: Quotation follow-up
templates.use: One consolidated RFP chaser sequence: first after 3 days, then every 3 days; maximum 2.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: Checking in on our request for {{scope}} for {{event}}. Could you send your itemized quote by {{reply_by}}? If you’re unable to take this one on, just let us know so we can plan ahead.

templates.name: Notice of award
templates.use: From Kiko’s Gmail after Kiko’s approval. A supplier Canvas button may be added only if an authorized award view is available; do not imply clicking accepts a contract.
templates.subject: You’re part of the plan | {{scope}} | {{event}}

blocks.text: You’re part of the plan! We’ve selected {{supplier}} for {{scope}} for {{event}} on {{event_date}}.
Please reply to acknowledge the award and {{required_next_step}} by {{reply_by}}.
Let’s make it a great one.

templates.name: Installment payment notice
templates.use: First or middle installment only. Send after the transfer is verified. Never describe a pending transfer as received.
templates.subject: Payment sent | {{event}} | Payment {{payment_number}} of {{payment_count}}

blocks.text: Payment {{payment_number}} of {{payment_count}} for {{event}} is on its way—we’ve sent the transfer.
The details and available payment proof are in Canvas. Take a look, and give us a heads-up if anything doesn’t match your records.

templates.name: Final installment payment notice
templates.use: Use only when the covered scope is reconciled to zero. Do not claim the entire supplier account is fully paid.
templates.subject: Final payment sent | {{event}}

blocks.text: The final installment for {{covered_scope}} for {{event}} has been sent.
Thanks for helping bring this event together. You’ll find the details and available payment proof in Canvas. If anything needs checking, just reply.

templates.name: Aggregated payment notice
templates.use: One email to the payee. List every covered item and its allocation; allocations must sum to total sent. Do not use one item’s URL for the whole group.
templates.subject: Payment sent | {{item_count}} items | {{payee}}

blocks.text: One transfer, a few items covered. Here’s the breakdown of the payment we’ve sent:
You’ll find the breakdown and available payment proof in Canvas. If an allocation doesn’t match your records, reply and we’ll check it together.

templates.name: Single payment notice
templates.use: Use only for a verified payment in full for the stated scope.
templates.subject: Payment sent | {{covered_scope}} | {{event}}

blocks.text: Your full payment for {{covered_scope}} for {{event}} has been sent.
Thanks for being part of this event. The details and available payment proof are in Canvas. Give us a heads-up if anything needs checking.

templates.name: Supplier final event reminder
templates.use: Call time and contact on the day are mandatory. Attach all selected gate passes, permits, maps or briefs and list them in the email; a Canvas link does not replace a required attachment.
templates.subject: Almost showtime | {{event}} | {{event_date}}

blocks.text: Almost showtime for {{event}}! Here’s what you’ll need for a smooth arrival and setup.
Your event brief is in Canvas. Take a look and reply to let us know you’ve got everything. If anything may affect your arrival or delivery, give us a heads-up right away.

templates.name: Supplier invoice request
templates.use: Use verified billing details and an authorized upload route. If upload is unavailable, replace the upload sentence and button with “Please reply with your invoice attached.”
templates.subject: Invoice request | {{event}} | {{request_id}}

blocks.text: One more thing to wrap up: please upload your official invoice for {{covered_scope}} for {{event}}.
You can upload it through the Canvas link below. Need help? Reply here and we’ll sort it out.

templates.name: Invoice follow-up
templates.use: Every 3 days; maximum 3. Use the reply-with-attachment fallback if the upload route is unavailable.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: We’re still missing the invoice for {{covered_scope}} for {{event}} (₱{{invoice_amount}}). Could you upload it to Canvas by {{due_date}}?
Already sent it? Thanks—let us know and we’ll check the record.

templates.name: Supplier acknowledgement receipt
templates.use: Link directly to this receipt, never to Payments. Preserve the sender’s edited introduction in the final rendered email.
templates.subject: Sign your acknowledgement receipt | {{event}}

blocks.text: Your Acknowledgement Receipt for {{covered_scope}} for {{event}} is ready in Canvas.
Please check the details and sign once you’ve confirmed the payment has reached you. Spotted something that needs fixing? Reply before signing and we’ll check it.

templates.name: Supplier receipt follow-up
templates.use: Every 3 days; maximum 3. Stop as soon as the receipt is signed.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: One signature to wrap this up: your Acknowledgement Receipt for {{event}} (₱{{amount}}) is ready in Canvas. Please sign once you’ve confirmed the payment has reached you.
If it hasn’t arrived or a detail needs fixing, reply here and we’ll check.

templates.name: Welcome to Canvas
templates.use: One manual email replaces the separate invitation and access emails. Verify the sign-in method before release.
templates.subject: You’re part of the crew | Welcome to Canvas

blocks.text: Welcome aboard, {{first_name}}! We’re glad to have you in the Blank Space Events crew. From first idea to final cue, it takes a good team—and you’re part of it.
Canvas is your home base for event assignments, documents and payments. Sign in with {{email}} using the 6-digit code sent to you each time.
Can’t get in? Reply here and we’ll help you get sorted.

templates.name: Crew role assignment
templates.use: Manual. State the agreed rate basis explicitly: per day, per event or another confirmed basis.
templates.subject: Your role for {{event}} | {{role}}

blocks.text: You’re on the crew! You’ll be joining {{event}} as {{role}}.
Your Freelancer Service Agreement will follow. For now, take a look at your assignment in Canvas and let us know if anything needs checking.
Glad to have you with us.

templates.name: Item assigned
templates.use: Automatic on assignment. Item type must be task, issue, risk or scope. Use only the assignee’s authorized item URL.
templates.subject: Assigned to you | {{item_title}} | {{event}}

blocks.text: You’ve got a new {{item_type}} from {{assigned_by}} for {{event}}:
Take a look in Canvas and keep the item updated as you go. If you need a detail cleared up, just reply.

templates.name: Freelancer service agreement
templates.subject: Review and sign your service agreement | {{event}}

blocks.text: Let’s get the details lined up. Your Freelancer Service Agreement for {{event}} is ready in Canvas. Check the role, dates, rate and terms, then sign when everything looks right.
Have a question or spotted something to fix? Reply before signing and we’ll talk it through.

templates.name: Service agreement follow-up
templates.use: First 1 day after the event, then every 2 days; maximum 3. Timing is preserved from the map; initial agreement should still be prepared before service.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: A quick nudge: your Freelancer Service Agreement for {{event}} is waiting in Canvas. Take a look and sign when the details are right.
Need something checked first? Just reply here.
Your Acknowledgement Receipt for {{event}} is ready in Canvas.
Please check the details and sign once you’ve confirmed the payment has reached you. If anything looks off, reply before signing and we’ll check it.

templates.name: Crew receipt follow-up
templates.use: First 1 day after the event, then every 2 days; maximum 3.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: One signature to wrap this up: your Acknowledgement Receipt for {{event}} (₱{{amount}}) is waiting in Canvas. Please sign once you’ve confirmed the payment has reached you.
If it hasn’t arrived or a detail needs fixing, reply here.

templates.name: Liquidation request
templates.use: Do not say to “upload the remaining balance.” Money is returned; receipts and return proof are uploaded.
templates.subject: Liquidation due | {{request_id}} | {{event}}

blocks.text: Let’s wrap up the cash advance for {{event}}. Please complete the liquidation for {{request_id}} by {{due_date}}.
Add the receipts and itemized expenses in Canvas. If there’s money left over, record the unused balance, return it using the confirmed payment instructions, and upload the return proof.
Missing a receipt or need a hand? Reply here so we can work through it.

templates.name: Liquidation follow-up
templates.use: Copy prepared only. Chaser timing remains undecided; do not activate a schedule.
templates.subject: Re: {{original_subject}}

blocks.text: A quick nudge to close out cash advance {{request_id}} for {{event}} (₱{{advance_amount}}). Please add the expense breakdown and receipts in Canvas by {{due_date}}.
If there’s an unused balance, record it and upload proof of its return. Need a hand completing the record? Just reply.

templates.name: Crew final event reminder
templates.use: Call time and contact on the day are mandatory. Attach selected event documents and list the actual attachments.
templates.subject: Almost showtime | {{event}} | {{event_date}}

blocks.text: Almost showtime, {{first_name}}! Here’s your final rundown for {{event}}.
Your event brief is in Canvas. Take a look and reply to confirm you’re all set. If anything may affect your arrival, give us a heads-up right away.
See you on site—let’s make it a great one!
Hi {{first_name}}, I’m Kiko from Blank Space Events. We plan and produce corporate and employee events, from town halls to year-end celebrations. I’d be glad to connect with you.
Use: Validate the rendered note is under 300 characters; shorten variable values if needed.

templates.key: C1C After a connection is accepted
templates.name: After a connection is accepted

blocks.text: Thanks for connecting, {{first_name}}! Here’s a look at what we bring to life: {{portfolio_url}}. If there’s an event taking shape at {{company}}, I’d love to hear about it. Imagine. Create. Celebrate.
Hi {{first_name}}, I’m Kiko from Blank Space Events. We plan and produce corporate and employee events. May I send you our portfolio for {{company}}’s future event requirements?
Use: Draft copy only; outreach specifications and approval workflow remain pending. Share {{portfolio_url}} after permission or when the conversation already supports it.
Welcome to the Blank Space Events crew! Step into Canvas: {{canvas_url}}. Sign in with {{email}}. Reply if you need help.
BSE: You’re assigned as {{role}} for {{event}} on {{event_date}}. Review your assignment: {{crew_assignment_url}}.
BSE: Your service agreement for {{event}} is ready. Review and sign: {{fsa_signing_url}}. Reply if a detail needs correction.
BSE: Your receipt for {{event}} (₱{{amount}}) is ready. Sign after confirming payment: {{ar_signing_url}}.
BSE: Liquidation for {{request_id}}, {{event}} (₱{{advance_amount}}), is due {{due_date}}. Upload receipts and return proof: {{liquidation_url}}.
BSE: {{event}}, {{event_date}}. Call time: {{call_time}}. Meet at {{meeting_point}}. Contact: {{onsite_contact_name}} {{onsite_mobile}}. Brief: {{crew_event_brief_url}}.
